_comment: EXAMPLE DATA — these zones describe an invented ground. Replace them with
your own, or delete this file if your club has no pitch map.
Where each pitch sits on club/images/web/pitch-map.jpg, as percentages of
that image from its top-left corner. A session plan writes the code —
![caption](pitch:2b) — and the build pins the team's marker on the spot.
Name the halves the way people at your club actually say them. An unknown
code fails the build, which is what stops a plan sending thirty players to
the wrong end of the ground.
